description: This Java class `PropertyAnimations` demonstrates how to implement property animations using Android's animation API, including ObjectAnimator, PropertyValuesHolder, and AnimatorSet. It features several buttons that perform different animations such as fading, translating, rotating, and scaling, either directly or via animation resource files. The class also provides a method to load pre-defined animations from XML resources when toggle checked.

classes.name: PropertyAnimations
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating property animations on various buttons

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons and animations

methods.description: Sets up click listener for views to start either code-based or resource-based animations
